# PharmaCRO

> A planned network of GMP pharmaceutical analytical testing laboratories (pre-launch). Figures on this site are illustrative placeholders until verified.

## Services
- [Every test your product needs, from first batch to final release.](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/index): Twelve services across the whole product lifecycle, one portal and one data standard. Search, filter, compare, or ask a scientist.
- [Bundles](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/bundles): Five packaged programmes, each with one plan, one timeline and one price.
- [Compare services](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/compare): All twelve services side by side: turnaround, sample need, regulatory coverage and lead labs.
- [Small Molecule QC and Release](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/small-molecule-qc-release): Compendial and custom release testing for tablets, capsules, liquids, injectables and APIs, from assay to nitrosamines.
- [Stability Studies](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/stability-studies): ICH stability programmes in every climatic zone, I to IVb, with pull testing, trending and shelf-life support.
- [Method Development, Validation and Transfer](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/method-development-validation): HPLC, UPLC, GC, LC-MS and dissolution methods developed with QbD, validated to ICH Q2(R2) and transferred between labs first time.
- [Biologics Characterization and Release](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/biologics-characterization-release): Characterisation, comparability and release testing for monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins and biosimilars.
- [mRNA and Vaccine Testing](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/mrna-vaccine-testing): Release and characterisation for mRNA therapeutics, LNP formulations and vaccines.
- [Cell and Gene Therapy Testing](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/cell-gene-therapy-testing): Release and characterisation for AAV and lentiviral vectors, CAR-T and other cell therapies, with rapid methods for fresh products.
- [Microbiology and Sterility](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/microbiology-sterility): Sterility, endotoxin, bioburden, mycoplasma and container closure testing to USP, Ph. Eur. and JP, with rapid methods when the clock matters
- [Environmental Monitoring and Cleanrooms](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/environmental-monitoring): Viable and non-viable monitoring, water and gas testing, and cleanroom classification, designed around your contamination control strategy.
- [Extractables and Leachables](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/extractables-leachables): Extractables studies, leachables on stability and packaging compatibility, designed from a risk assessment and reported to an analytical eva
- [Bioanalytical and Immunogenicity](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/bioanalytical-immunogenicity): LC-MS/MS and ligand-binding PK assays, tiered anti-drug antibody testing and neutralising antibody assays, validated to ICH M10.
- [Reference Standards and Excipient Testing](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/reference-standards-excipients): Compendial testing of excipients, APIs and reference standards to USP-NF, Ph. Eur., JP and IP, plus in-house standard qualification.
- [Regulatory and Data Integrity Support](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/services/regulatory-data-integrity-support): Mock inspections, ALCOA+ data integrity gap assessments, CTD Module 3 analytical sections and OOS investigation support, from people who hav

## Solutions
- [Discovery](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/discovery): Fit-for-purpose methods and early characterisation. Discovery methods are fit for purpose, not validated. The aim is reliable enough data to
- [Preclinical](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/preclinical): GLP-aware characterisation and tox batch support. Preclinical methods are qualified: shown to be suitable for the tox batch, but not fully v
- [Clinical (Phase 1 to 3)](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/clinical-phase-1-3): Phase-appropriate validation, release and stability. Phase 1 methods: fit for purpose, not fully validated. Methods are validated to ICH Q2(
- [Commercial release](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/commercial-release): Validated, fast, routine batch release. Commercial release uses fully validated methods, registered specifications and strict change control
- [Post-approval and stability](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/post-approval-stability): Ongoing stability, changes and lifecycle management. Post-approval work follows the registered stability commitment and ICH Q12 lifecycle pr
- [Testing for every stage, from first molecule to final batch.](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/solutions/index): From discovery to post-approval stability: the testing each stage needs, and how much rigour is enough.

## Industries
- [Generics](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/generics): Tight margins and tight launch windows. Generic manufacturers need fast, cheap, defensible release testing and a clean answer on nitrosamine
- [Biosimilars](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/biosimilars): Proving similarity to a moving reference product. Biosimilar developers must show their molecule is highly similar to a reference product th
- [Biotech startups](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/biotech-startups): No internal lab, a small team and a board deadline. Early biotechs usually have no internal lab, a small team and a board deadline.
- [Big pharma](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/big-pharma): Overflow capacity and global consistency. Large pharmaceutical companies use PharmaCRO for overflow capacity, regional release and specialis
- [CDMOs](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/cdmos): Your clients' timelines become your timelines. CDMOs carry their clients' timelines.
- [Vaccine makers](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/vaccine-makers): High stakes, high volume, no margin for error. Vaccine makers test high volumes under high stakes, often with cold-chain samples and short r
- [API manufacturers](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/api-manufacturers): Impurity profiles every regulator will read. API manufacturers sell impurity profiles as much as molecules.
- [Excipient and packaging suppliers](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/excipient-packaging-suppliers): Your customers' auditors are your auditors. Excipient and packaging suppliers are audited by every customer's QA.
- [Built around how you make medicines.](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/industries/index): Eight kinds of medicine makers, eight sets of pressures. See the package and tools built for yours.

- [HPLC assay and related substances](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/method-library/hplc-assay-related-substances): Chromatography method to USP , Ph. Eur. 2.2.46, JP 2.01. Typical sample: typically 20 tablets or capsules, or 1 to 5 g of API. Indicative tu
- [UHPLC impurity profiling](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/method-library/uplc-impurity-profiling): Chromatography method to USP , Ph. Eur. 2.2.46, ICH Q3A(R2). Typical sample: 0.5 to 2 g of API or 10 dosage units. Indicative turnaround: 3 
- [Dissolution testing](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/method-library/dissolution-testing): Dissolution and performance method to USP , USP , USP . Typical sample: 12 to 24 units per batch (6 per stage). Indicative turnaround: 2 to

- [Residual solvents by headspace GC](https://pharma.eliteleadgrow.com/method-library/residual-solvents-gc-hs): Chromatography method to USP , Ph. Eur. 2.4.24, ICH Q3C. Typical sample: 1 to 2 g of API, excipient or product. Indicative turnaround: 3 to
